blocks.value: Technical Analysis studies price charts. Fundamental Analysis studies the business itself. Before investing, it's important to understand what a company does and how it earns money.
Imagine This: Before buying a house, you don't just look at its paint. You inspect the structure, location, documents and condition. Buying shares should be no different.

Every listed company publishes information such as its business activities, products, financial results, promoters and annual reports. Investors use this information to evaluate whether the company is worth investing in.
When researching Infosys, you might learn that it provides IT consulting and software services to customers across the world.
Never invest in a company whose business you don't understand.
